source: Molecule outputs are the display names of the en_US lang file (molecule.<id>). Fluid inputs are keyed fluid:<name>; only the vanilla fluids water and lava are here (milk and the molten metals, ender, etc. are mod or Forge fluids, not in NeoForge 26.1 vanilla, so they are left out).

recipes.basis: The fluid registry constant is added first; a later duplicate for the same fluid is ignored.

Grains of the End: iridium, the element of extraterrestrial rock (meteorites). Real-world match for the End.
Soul dust: bone-like calcium phosphate, the nearest real material to the sand of the afterlife. Real-world match.
Grains of Vibrancy: neon, the gas that glows in signs. Real-world match.
Grains of Piezallity: lead zirconate titanate (PZT), the piezoelectric ceramic. Real-world match, written as its elements.
Withering: thallium, a poisonous metal (it withers the body). Real-world match, non-radioactive on purpose.
Grains of Prescience: helium, found in the spectrum of the Sun before it was found on Earth. Real-world match.
Confusion Powder: mercury, whose poisoning confused its victims (the mad hatter). Real-world match.
